title: JSONL suffix resume is deliberately unbuilt. A changed artifact is
blocker: recaptured whole. Measured at 25,000 artifacts the changed pass costs 1.72s against a 22.691s bound, so the checkpoint machinery - prefix chunk hashes, a cached normalized accumulator, an incomplete-tail boundary - is correctness surface nobody is paying for yet. Build it when a real artifact misses the bound, not before. **Blocked on:** a real artifact missing the 22.691 s bound; none has (re-checked 2026-09-09, the changed pass measures 1.72 s).
